children: was downgraded to Neutral from Buy at BofA Securities on net asset value discount.
"With credit deteriorating, earnings power fading, and self-help levers limited, we view the ~0.6x NAV discount as justified rather than an entry point," said Derek Hewett.
Price objective was reduced to $10.25 from $13.00. Shares were 3.03% lower at $9.92 during afternoon trading on Thursday.

"Recent management fee cuts help at the margin but are not enough to change the trajectory in our view; we would need to see credit and NAV stabilize before the deep discount valuation becomes a reason to turn more constructive," said Hewett.
